info.title: KNOWALL — Module 1 API
info.description: Single-society demo backend. All state-changing /api operations require an X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/auth/csrf. The session cookie is HttpOnly and stored by the browser. Use GET /api/auth/csrf before login and again after login (login rotates the CSRF token). Swagger UI cannot set browser authentication cookies manually: execute login in the same Swagger origin, then try protected endpoints. Demo console email links are development-only. Phase 6 adds draft/submission and invitation APIs. Pending applications DO NOT confer resident rights. Phase 7 adds private document upload and on-demand OCR; Phase 8 adds human administrator approvals, correction/rejection workflows, memberships and audit history. Enhancement: optional personal details, sponsored-family relationship, household family tree and administrator-confirmed current occupancy. No voting system is added. Family administrator review enhancement: explicit, live sponsor_context and advisory OCR-to-sponsor name comparison. No automatic family relationship validation or eligibility based on occupancy.

get.description: Returns current user roles, verified active memberships and effective permission codes. Permissions are display hints to the frontend, never authority for a Flask endpoint. Owner/tenant/family is a membership category rather than a permission role. Access can change immediately after suspension, expiry, sponsor ineligibility or revocation. Future-module permission names indicate shared capability contracts only; each module must also enforce resource-specific eligibility.

Owner/Tenant invitations continue to create DRAFT applications. Legacy family applications remain unchanged. 200 is not returned for success: two possible 201 contracts distinguished by outcome.
